table: Munsell renotation (1943), RIT real.dat transcription, 2734 chromatic samples
method: The standard's notation interpolated linearly in the table (chroma on each neighbouring hue page, then hue, then value; Y from the ASTM D1535 value polynomial), Bradford-adapted from illuminant C to D65, compared with the page's sRGB value by CIEDE2000 in CIELAB. Differences only; derived colours are not recorded.
